# Read-only clock diagnostic: wall-minus-monotonic offset every 5 s for 60 s. Changes nothing.
import time, json
t0w, t0m = time.time(), time.monotonic()
rows = []
for i in range(13):
    if i: time.sleep(5)
    w, m = time.time(), time.monotonic()
    rows.append(round(((w - t0w) - (m - t0m)) * 1000, 1))
print(json.dumps({'offset_ms_every_5s': rows, 'drift_ms_per_min': round((rows[-1] - rows[0]), 1)}))
print('DIAGNOSTIC only: wall-clock minus monotonic offset; not CI acceptance')
